turns.q: Do you like Japan?
turns.answer:
Loved it — I spent time there near the tail end of a long trip through Asia, and after months of moving fast it was the place I finally slowed down and stayed put. What got me wasn't the sights so much as the people; I ended up hanging around a studio in Kyoto with a collective of architects and designers, and that's the bit that stuck.

I'm a sucker for printing and type too, so places like the Printing Museum in Tokyo were right up my street.

turns.q: Tell me about the White Paper project
turns.answer:
White Paper are a UK CPD conference provider I've worked with for a long while now — I designed and built their booking engine and on-demand platform. The core problem was that getting from a programme page to a completed booking took far too many steps, and their conference data was scattered across disconnected systems with no clear view of what was selling.

I pulled it all into a single content repository, split the checkout into manageable tasks, and automated a lot of what used to be manual admin. It's an ongoing relationship — I'm still improving it now.
